name: PostHog
tagline: Product analytics API with events, feature flags, and session data
description: PostHog is a product analytics platform offering REST APIs for querying events, managing feature flags, persons, insights, and project data. Hosted Cloud (US/EU) and self-hosted deployments are supported; capture and query endpoints enable analytics automation and integrations.
base_url: US public: https://us.i.posthog.com; US private: https://us.posthog.com; EU public: https://eu.i.posthog.com; EU private: https://eu.posthog.com

auth.details: Personal API key via Authorization: Bearer header for private endpoints; project API key for public capture endpoints. Self-serve signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Monthly: 1M analytics events, 5K session recordings, 1M feature-flag requests, 100K exceptions, 1,500 survey responses, 1M warehouse rows, 100K AI-observability events, 500 AI credits, and 10 GB of logs, plus other product-specific allowances.

rate_limits: Private API: analytics 240/min and 1,200/hour; events/values 60/min and 300/hour; query 2,400/hour; local flag evaluation 600/min; other CRUD 480/min and 4,800/hour. Public POST capture and flag endpoints have no request-level limit.

example.request: curl -sS -L -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"api_key":"<ph_project_token>","event":"event name","distinct_id":"user distinct id"}' https://us.i.posthog.com/i/v0/e/
